title: setup verify + storage survey (safe, kuch delete nahi)

steps.text: Yeh task sirf bridge test karta hai. 2 chhoti files Download/BuildStudio/ me banengi.

steps.content:
Build Studio <-> Termux agent
================================
Yeh folder agent ka drop-box hai. Jo bhi main (Arena chat wala agent) yahan likhta hoon, woh
phone par yahi milega.

Roz ke commands:
  bhai sync     - naye instructions uthaake apply karo
  bhai watch    - har 30 second me auto-sync (agent mode)
  bhai up FILE  - file mujhe bhejo taaki main edit karun
  bhai down     - mere edits original jagah wapas
  bhai du       - space ka hisaab
  bhai report   - summary (mujhe chat me paste kardo)
  bhai doctor   - sab thik hai?

Sabse bura case: kuch galat lage to
  ls ~/.bhai/trash     -> delete hui cheezein yahin hain, wapas le lo

steps.cmd: for d in DCIM Pictures Movies Download WhatsApp Music Documents; do p=~/storage/shared/$d; [ -d "$p" ] && printf '%-12s %s files\n' "$d" "$(find "$p" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"; done
